senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. קָרַר I)to dig, chisel, esp. to whet a millstone.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 10a:16">M. Kat. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>נוֹקְרִין ריחים וכ׳</he> you may roughen a millstone during the festive week.
<cite ref="Shabbat 130a:16">Sabb. 130ᵃ</cite> <he>יִקְּרוּ את מוחו</he> they shall perforate (or put out) his brain.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 1:8">Sot. I, 8</cite> <he>נָקְרוּ פלשתים וכ׳</he> (or <he>נִקְּרוּ</he>) the Philistines put out his eyes; a. e.

senses.gloss: (of birds, mice, serpents &c.) to pick, gnaw at.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 7:17">Tosef. Ter. VII, 17</cite>. Y. ib. III, beg. 42ᵃ <he>בשראו אותו נוֹקֵר</he> when they saw the bird pick; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 10:3:5">Y. Yeb. X, 11ᵃ</cite> top <he>לבי נוקריני</he>, v. <cite ref="N01162"><he>נָקַד</he> I</cite>.]—Part. pass. <cite ref="N01185"><he>נָקוּר</he></cite>; pl. <cite ref="N00972"><he>נְקוּרִים</he></cite>, <he>נְקוּרִין</he>. Y. Ter. l. c. Tosef. l. c. <he>שמא נ׳ היו</he> may be they were already picked at (by birds); a. e.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="N01240">same</cite>. M. Kat. l. c. <he>מְנַקֵּר ריחים</he>, v. supra.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:5">Sot. IX, 5</cite> <he>ולנַקֵּר שם וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Sotah 46b:5">ib. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>ולנקור</he>) and to chisel stones there.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 8b:7">Pes. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>תרנגולתך מְנַקֶּרֶת וכ׳</he> (not <he>מנקר</he>) thy hen shall be picking in the dunghill &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 4:3">Toh. IV, 3</cite> <he>היו מְנַקְּרִין בהן וכ׳</he> if they have been picking them (the pieces of carrion) on the ground; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be picked at. Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᶜ top תאנים שנִיקְּרוּ … figs or grapes which have been picked at.
